# glinet_openvpn_server (Resource)

Manage one OpenWrt OpenVPN server section. Certificate and key file paths are managed as values; the files themselves are not managed.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) UCI OpenVPN section name.

### Optional

- `ca` (String) CA certificate path.
- `cert` (String) Server certificate path.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `dev` (String) Device type.
- `dh` (String) Diffie-Hellman parameters path.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this server.
- `key` (String) Server key path.
- `port` (Number) Listening port.
- `proto` (String) Transport protocol.
- `server` (String) Server subnet and netmask.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `owner` (String) Owner token recorded with the router section. It detects another Terraform state that manages the same section.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
